Subject: Sales runway: account census + consolidated forecast (QBR prep)

Team —

We need a compact, account-by-account bundle for the QBR deck. High level asks below so we can consolidate by next Friday (EOD Apr 23):

1) One-pager per assigned account (pdf) — current ARR, next milestone, known risks, recommended play, expected close date.
2) Update the attached account-rollup.csv with your best-case / likely / downside ARR numbers for Q2 (cols: owner, product, commit, close_date).
3) Flag any accounts where we need an exec intro or legal support.

Priority accounts: Acme Corporation (RDW-ACME-2027-Q2), BetaCorp, NovelHealth. If you own other mid-range deals (50k–250k) add them to the rollup.

Notes:
- We are aiming for a single forecast line per account in the consolidated sheet; include commentary in the one-pager if there is split risk (e.g., parts of the deal slipping to Q3).
- If you think we should apply a 15–25% internal tempo discount for ops risk, call it out in the comment column.

Attachments: account-rollup.csv (spreadsheet stub). I also linked the working folder here: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/QBR-2027/accounts/ACME

Please ACK with owner assignments by EOD today. I'll take point on the deck stitching once I have the raw one-pagers and the updated rollup.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Marcus —

Ack and will own Acme + NovelHealth one-pagers. Quick notes as I fill the templates (attaching ACME_onepager_v2.pdf, ACME_mutual_action_plan.docx):

- Acme Corporation
  • Current ARR (Redwood): $185,000 annualized; primary use: multi-tenant hosted API for inference.
  • Forecast: Commit = $140k (likely), Upside = $185k (stretch) — conservative view assumes a 30% procurement delay.
  • Risk: procurement SLA and SOC2 attestation timing (they request SOC2 Type 2 evidence in RFP).
  • Ask: Exec intro to CTO (they asked to speak with someone who can speak to private deployment timelines).
  • Close date: previously 2027-05-15; sending updated language to them this week.

- NovelHealth
  • I only have initial interest; assigning to QE for a one-pager request.

I've updated the account-rollup.csv with my columns filled and left comment flags where legal or SOC evidence is needed.

Attachments: ACME_onepager_v2.pdf (one-pager stub), ACME_mutual_action_plan.docx (docx stub).
